arxiv-2012-05553.title: Physical and Chemical Structure of the Disk and Envelope of the Class 0/I protostar L1527 Facilities: ALMA, CARMA, HERSCHEL, IRSA, Spitzer, TIFKAM, IRAC, MIPS, SCUBA, JCMT/UKT, NMA

arxiv-2012-05553.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Lizxandra Flores-Rivera, Susan Terebey, Karen Willacy, Andrea Isella, Neal Turner, Mario Flock. Sub-millimeter spectral line and continuum emission from the protoplanetary disks and envelopes of protostars are powerful probes of their structure, chemistry, and dynamics.

arxiv-2012-15493.title: Quantum digital signatures with smaller public keys
arxiv-2012-15493.creator: Boris Škorić
arxiv-2012-15493.description: Abstract We introduce a variant of quantum signatures in which nonbinary symbols are signed instead of bits. The public keys are fingerprinting states, just as in the scheme of Gottesman and Chuang [ 1 ] , but we allow for multiple ways to reveal the private key partially.

arxiv-2105-11665.title: A Taxonomy Study on Securing Blockchain-based Industrial Applications: An Overview, Application Perspectives, Requirements, Attacks, Countermeasures, and Open Issues Journal: Journal of L a T e X Templates
arxiv-2105-11665.creator: Khizar Hameed, Mutaz Barika, Saurabh Garg, Muhammad Bilal Amin, Byeong Kang
arxiv-2105-11665.description: Abstract Blockchain technology has taken on a leading role in today’s industrial applications by providing salient features and showing significant performance since its beginning. Blockchain began its journey from the concept of cryptocurrency and is now part of a range of core applications to achieve resilience and automation between various tasks.

arxiv-2110-13926.title: Supercool Composite Dark Matter Beyond 100 TeV
arxiv-2110-13926.creator: Iason Baldes
arxiv-2110-13926.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Iason Baldes. ULB-TH/21-17 DESY 21-171 Abstract Dark matter could be a composite state of a confining sector with an approximate scale symmetry. We consider the case where the associated pseudo-Goldstone boson, the dilaton, mediates its interactions with the Standard Model. When the confining phase transition in the early universe is supercooled, its dynamics allows for dark matter masses up to 10^{6} TeV.

arxiv-2212-11510.title: Characterization of Quantumness of non-Gaussian states under the influence of Gaussian channel
arxiv-2212-11510.creator: Ramniwas Meena, Subhashish Banerjee
arxiv-2212-11510.description: Abstract The impact of a noisy Gaussian channel on a wide range of non-Gaussian input states is studied in this work. The nonclassical nature of the states, both input and output, is developed by studying the corresponding photon statistics and quasi-probability distributions.

arxiv-2303-03855.title: GRB 221009A, its precursor and two afterglows in the Fermi data 2023 GRB 221009A, its precursor and two afterglows in the Fermi data – References
arxiv-2303-03855.creator: Boris E. Stern, I.I. Tkachev
arxiv-2303-03855.description: Abstract We study GRB 221009A, the brightest gamma-ray burst in the history of observations, using Fermi data. To calibrate them for large inclination angles, we use the Vela X gamma-ray source. Light curves in different spectral ranges demonstrate a 300 s overlap of afterglow and delayed episodes of soft prompt emission.

arxiv-2308-06473.title: Observation of the X17 anomaly in the decay of the Giant Dipole Resonance of 8 Be
arxiv-2308-06473.creator: A.J. Krasznahorkay, A. Krasznahorkay, M. Csatlós, L. Csige, J. Timár, M. Begala, A. Krakó, I. Rajta, I. Vajda, N.J. Sas
arxiv-2308-06473.description: Abstract Angular correlation spectra of e + ​ e − e^{+}e^{-} pairs produced in the 7 Li( p p , γ \gamma ) 8 Be nuclear reaction were studied at a proton beam energy of E p E_{p} = 4.0 MeV, which corresponds to the excitation energy of the Giant Dipole Resonance (GDR) in 8 Be.

arxiv-2309-13795.title: Modelling and Search-Based Testing of Robot Controllers Using Enzymatic Numerical P Systems
arxiv-2309-13795.creator: Radu Traian Bobe Florentin Ipate Ionuţ Mihai Niculescu
arxiv-2309-13795.description: Abstract The safety of the systems controlled by software is a very important area in a digitalized society, as the number of automated processes is increasing. In this paper, we present the results of testing the accuracy of different lane keeping controllers for an educational robot.

arxiv-2502-04156.title: Estimation of backgrounds from jets misidentified as τ \tau -leptons using the Universal Fake Factor method with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2502-04156.description: Abstract Processes with τ \tau -leptons in the final state are important for Standard Model measurements and searches for physics beyond the Standard Model. The ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider observes τ \tau -leptons produced in proton–proton collisions only through their decay products.

The benefits to plants by inoculation with Azospirillum have been primarily attributed to its capacity to fix atmospheric nitrogen, but also to its capacity to synthesize...

plos-pone-0009242.creator: Marc Trimborn, Mahdi Ghani, Diego J. Walther et al.
plos-pone-0009242.description: PLOS ONE research article. Mutations in the human gene MCPH1 cause primary microcephaly associated with a unique cellular phenotype with premature chromosome condensation (PCC) in early G2 phase and delayed decondensation post-mitosis (PCC syndrome). The gene encodes the BRCT-domain containing protein micr

pmc-11509903.title: Computational Workflow to Design Novel Vaccine Candidates and Small-Molecule Therapeutics for Schistosomiasis
pmc-11509903.creator: Emmanuel Oluwadare Balogun, Gideon Ibrahim Joseph, Samuel Charles Olabode, Naziru Abdulkadir Dayaso, Ammar Usman Danazumi, Rachael Bashford-Rogers, James H Mckerrow, Ghulam Jeelani, Conor R Caffrey, Martina Sombetzki, Emil Christian Reisinger
pmc-11509903.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Human schistosomiasis, caused by the Schistosoma trematode, is a neglected parasitic disease affecting over 250 million people worldwide. There is no vaccine, and the single available drug is threatened by drug resistance. This study presents a computational approach to designing multiepitope vaccines (MEVs) targeting the cercarial (CMEV) and schistosomular (SMEV) stages of schistosomes, and identifies potential schistosomicidal compounds from the Medicine for Malaria Ventures (MMV) and SuperNatural Database (SND) libraries.

pmc-12471940.title: Microwave Synthesis in Zeolite and MOF Membranes
pmc-12471940.creator: Liangqing Li
pmc-12471940.description: Zeolites and metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are crystalline porous materials characterized by highly ordered pore structures. Their fabrication into membranes has demonstrated significant potential for use in separation processes involving liquids or gases. Traditional methods for synthesizing these membranes often require prolonged reaction times and high energy input.

pmc-12514061.title: A feature fusion-based line structured light 3-D imaging method
pmc-12514061.creator: Jingjing Lou, Liangliang Sun, Yunhan Li, Chuan Ye, Yuhang Jiang
pmc-12514061.description: To address the challenges of uneven illumination, background noise, and low contrast in laser stripe center extraction in industrial environments such as measurement, this paper proposes a line laser 3D measurement method based on feature fusion. First, a multi-feature fusion detection model is constructed to obtain the brightness feature map and region-enhanced feature map of the laser stripe.

pmc-12571820.title: Misdiagnosed with spinal infection instead of SAPHO syndrome: a case report and literature review
pmc-12571820.creator: Shuai Wang, Shiyong Wan, Zhengqi Chang
pmc-12571820.description: This article reports a case of SAPHO syndrome misdiagnosed as spinal infection, detailing the clinical manifestations, laboratory tests, and imaging features of the patient. Through a review of the literature, common confounding factors and reasons for misdiagnosis in the diagnostic process of this disease are summarized.

pmc-13079004.title: Physicochemical composition and long-chain fatty acids in fresh and freeze-dried colostrum from cows and buffaloes
pmc-13079004.creator: Rosy G. Cruz-Monterrosa, J. Efrén Ramírez-Bribiesca, María M. Crosby-Galván, Elsa M. Crosby-Galván, Daniel Mota-Rojas, Ignacio A. Domínguez-Vara, Diana T. Ramírez, Ethel C. García y González
pmc-13079004.description: BackgroundColostrum is a functional food for newborn calves and can be preserved by refrigeration, freezing, or freeze-drying. The physicochemical characteristics of colostrum may or may not be affected by the freeze-drying process. No information is available on freeze-dried buffalo colostrum.

pmc-13095730.title: Exploring the repertoire of rhomboid proteases in Cryptosporidium parvum parasite: phylogenesis, structural motifs, and cellular localization in sporozoite cells
pmc-13095730.creator: Ilaria Vanni, Elisabetta Pizzi, Lucia Bertuccini, Alessandra Ludovisi, Fabio Tosini
pmc-13095730.description: Cryptosporidium parvum is an apicomplexan parasite and an important pathogen of mammals and humans, which can be infected by zoonotic transmission or directly by human-to-human contact. This parasite attacks the small intestine, and the main symptom is a watery diarrhea that can be particularly severe in newborns and deadly in immunodeficient subjects.

pmc-13240770.title: Factors associated with psychological distress among newly diagnosed patients with gastric cancer: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13240770.creator: Hyunju Ji, Ji Yea Lee
pmc-13240770.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the factors associated with psychological distress in patients newly diagnosed with gastric cancer.MethodsThis study used a descriptive cross-sectional design. The participants were 173 patients newly diagnosed with gastric cancer who had not yet initiated any treatment. They were recruited from a tertiary hospital in South Korea between December 2023 and September 2025.

pmc-13427634.title: High-speed non-volatile barium titanate field-programmable photonic gate array
pmc-13427634.creator: Cristina Catalá-Lahoz, Jose Roberto Rausell-Campo, Daniel Pérez-López, Lucas Güniat, Clarissa Convertino, Felix Eltes, Jean Fompeyrine, Charis Mesaritakis, Adonis Bogris, Quentin Wilmart, Jonathan Faugier-Tovar, Benoit Charbonnier, José Capmany
pmc-13427634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Programmable integrated photonics aims to replicate the versatility of field-programmable gate arrays in the optical domain. However, scaling these systems has been prevented by the high power consumption and thermal crosstalk of conventional volatile phase shifters. Here we introduce a non-volatile field-programmable photonic gate array, implemented on a hybrid silicon–barium titanate platform, which overcomes the power scaling limitations of previous technologies.

pmc-13437257.title: Contribution of One‐Electron Oxidation of Purine and Pyrimidine Bases to the Photo‐ and Radiation‐Induced Damage to Cellular DNA
pmc-13437257.creator: Jean Cadet, Dimitar Angelov, Paolo DI Mascio, J. Richard Wagner

pmc-13579951.title: Participants using GenAI in online studies: an overview and recommendations for researchers and reviewers
pmc-13579951.creator: Justus Mann, Jutta Stumpf-Wollersheim
pmc-13579951.description: BackgroundParticipants’ use of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to create responses in online studies can threaten data authenticity and research validity. This issue is particularly pressing in settings where participation is paid for. In response, researchers have begun to develop different approaches to prevent and detect GenAI use by participants.

pmc-13631680.title: “Am I Teaching into the Void?” Instructor Perceptions of Active Learning in Online Biology Courses
pmc-13631680.creator: Austin L Zuckerman, David Esparza, Yanwei C Liu, Michelle K Smith
pmc-13631680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SynopsisExtensive studies and meta-analyses have shown that active learning in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics courses improve equitable learning outcomes compared to traditional lecture. Before the COVID-19 pandemic, most active learning studies focused on in-person instruction, but as online and hybrid teaching continues to be explored as a potential avenue to deliver course content to more students, the field is exploring the efficacy of active learning practices in online courses.
